transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.message: Hello, this is calling from our company. Is this a good time to talk about your account?

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.message: Uh, hi… um, not really? I mean, I’m at work right now, kind of in the middle of things. Could you maybe call back later? I’ll try to figure something out, I promise.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.message:
Hi, this is Sarah Thompson from ClearPath Financial Solutions. I completely understand — thank you for letting me know you're busy at work. I don’t want to interrupt your day.

Absolutely, I can call you back. Would later this evening be better? Or is there a specific time tomorrow when you’d have a few minutes to talk? I just want to make sure we find a time that works well for you so we can go over your account and look at some options that fit your situation.

And don’t worry — we’ll figure this out together. I’m here to help, not add stress. Let me know what time works best, and I’ll make sure to call you then.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.message: Oh, um… thanks, Sarah, that’s nice of you. Maybe tomorrow? Like… late afternoon? I’ll be off work by then. But honestly, I’ve been meaning to look at my account, I just haven’t had the chance yet. I’ll try to check it tonight—maybe we can talk then? If that’s okay?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.message:
You're very welcome — and thank you for being honest and open about it. I really appreciate that.

Tomorrow late afternoon works well. How about I give you a call at 6:30 PM? That should give you some time to unwind after work and maybe look things over if you’re able to tonight. No pressure at all if you don’t get to it — we can still go over everything together when we talk.

Just to confirm, is this still the best number to reach you at?

And again, this is just about finding a plan that works for you. We’ll take it step by step. I’ll see you tomorrow around 6:30 PM, sound good?
